SELECT r.id,r.title,r.channel_id,r.description,r.video_url,r.poster_url,r.duration_seconds,r.publish_at,r.content_mode,
    COALESCE((SELECT st.n FROM social_interaction_totals st WHERE st.target_id=r.id AND st.type='view'),0) views,
    COALESCE((SELECT st.n FROM social_interaction_totals st WHERE st.target_id=r.id AND st.type='like'),0) likes,
  p.id AS lp_id, p.name AS lp_name, p.brand_name AS lp_brand_name,
  p.image AS lp_image, p.status AS lp_status,
  p.final_price AS lp_final_price, p.stock_status AS lp_stock_status
    FROM reels r LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=r.product_id
    WHERE r.status='publie' AND r.publish_at<=?
    ORDER BY r.publish_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT cp.content_id AS content_id, 
  p.id AS lp_id, p.name AS lp_name, p.brand_name AS lp_brand_name,
  p.image AS lp_image, p.status AS lp_status,
  p.final_price AS lp_final_price, p.stock_status AS lp_stock_status
       FROM content_products cp
       JOIN products p ON p.id = cp.product_id
      WHERE cp.content_kind = ? AND cp.content_id IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
      ORDER BY cp.sort_order, cp.product_id

SELECT p.*,

    FROM products p WHERE p.status='ACTIVE' AND p.visibility='CATALOG'

SELECT p.*,GROUP_CONCAT(pa.arrival_id) arrival_ids FROM products p
      LEFT JOIN product_arrivals pa ON pa.product_id=p.id WHERE p.id=? AND (p.status='ACTIVE' AND (p.visibility='CATALOG' OR (p.visibility='CONTENT' AND (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reels cr WHERE cr.product_id=p.id AND cr.status='publie' AND cr.publish_at<=?)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM publications cp WHERE cp.product_id=p.id AND cp.status='publie' AND cp.publish_at<=?)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stories cs WHERE cs.product_id=p.id AND cs.status='PUBLISHED'
               AND cs.publish_at<=? AND (cs.expires_at IS NULL OR cs.expires_at>?))
  )))) GROUP BY p.id
